players.product: Helios AI/HPC data-center campus (West Texas, 800 gross MW) leased to CoreWeave, plus Merlin / Caspian / Selene Texas development sites - ex-Bitcoin-mining site (Galaxy Power)

connects_to.relationship: Helios campus (West Texas) AI data-center capacity leased to CoreWeave - 800 gross MW across three phases (Phase I 133 MW critical IT delivered; Phase II 260 MW; Phase III 133 MW)

contracts.signal: Galaxy's investor presentation states Helios Project Speed Phase II (400 Gross MW / 260 MW critical IT load) is leased to CoreWeave: 15-year base lease term plus two 5-year CoreWeave extension options, $10.4Bn minimum contracted lease payments (remaining lease payments based on the 15-year initial lease term and 3% annual inflation, excluding a $100M options payment already received from CoreWeave), an initial targeted rent commencement date of Q2'27 and a 3.0-5.0% annual rent escalator. All 800 Gross MW of leased capacity at Helios (including the 400 Gross MW of Phase II) has CoreWeave as the tenant.
contracts.units: 260 MW Critical IT Load (400 Gross MW), Phase II
